name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $98 after its biggest weekly fall in years; US blockade and Hormuz attacks continue
state: Brent settled near $98.3 on 6 Nov, down 6.2% on the week and 6% in a month, inside the $85–110 Watch band (Yahoo Finance). Prices eased on US–Iran mediation via Qatar, while the US blockade of Iranian ports continues: US Central Command said on 7 Nov it had stopped more than $25bn of Iranian crude exports in recent months (RFE/RL). No new outage above 2 mb/d was confirmed this run.
for_you: Fuel prices tend to follow crude with a lag of a few weeks; the recent fall may ease pump prices if it holds.

sources.title: RFE/RL — Iran live blog: US forces disable ship seeking to break blockade

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
